@title Creditor
 @dev Central credit manager implementing comprehensive credit lifecycle management
 Core Responsibilities:
 - Tracking borrower credit lines and outstanding balances
 - Handling repayments (on-chain stablecoins and off-chain fiat)
 - Enforcing credit limits and repayment schedules
 - Updating credit lines based on behavior and risk assessments
 - Minting virtual credit tokens directly to merchants during spend transactions
 - Dynamic global credit allocation management (70% of vault TVL)
 - Preventing total credit supply from exceeding vault collateral limits
 - Managing merchant authorization (local mapping for gas efficiency)
 - Managing borrower registration (local mapping for fast checks)
 Access Control:
 - Uses TMRWAccessControl for admin roles (ADMIN_ROLE, ORACLE_ROLE, SUPER_ADMIN_ROLE)
 - Uses local mappings for frequent operations (merchant/borrower validation)
 - Hybrid approach optimizes gas costs while maintaining centralized admin control
